title: Neighborhood garden grows into a network of opportunity for local farmers
summary: What began as a neighborhood garden is now helping Iowa farmers access new markets, resources and training. With PepsiCo-supported funding, We Arose is building on that momentum and strengthening Waterloo’s local food network.
body_markdown:
Campbell started We Arose in 2019 as a small neighborhood garden. For two years, the team gave away its harvest while asking residents which crops mattered most and what prices could keep fresh food accessible while supporting a viable business. In 2021, We Arose moved into commercial production through farmers markets, home deliveries and a community-supported agriculture program, or CSA, which provides subscribers with regular selections of seasonal produce.


As We Arose grew, so did the challenge of helping more growers reach customers. Through a three-year PepsiCo-supported grant, Practical Farmers of Iowa has helped We Arose expand its farmers market and CSA work while connecting more growers to shared sales and distribution.


The name We Arose captures that community focus. “The ‘We’ is intentional,” said Campbell. “To me, farming and local food have always been about community. I wanted the name to make clear that this work was never just about one person.” The “Arose” evokes a rose growing through concrete — a symbol of moving forward despite historical barriers to land ownership and unequal access to land, capital and information. “The name acknowledges the challenges that have shaped our history, but it isn’t defined by those challenges,” said Campbell. “It’s about community and creating a path forward.”


Today, We Arose grows food and aggregates products from other small and emerging farmers, helping them reach customers through shared sales and distribution. Its CSA has grown from 15 subscribers to about 37, with a goal of 100. The local farmers market Campbell has managed since 2018 has expanded from 15 vendors to more than 40 and draws up to 1,200 customers a week during peak season.
